sources.sections: Four pillars; programme overview; Dutch three-year bachelor; graduate examples
sources.finding: Truth, ethics, persons, society and knowledge define the bachelor. Argument and text analysis are central; graduate examples do not generate bachelor alternatives.

sources.sections: Years 1–3 curriculum tables; GROW; two tracks; track examples
sources.finding: The General Philosophy pathway has 60 EC in each year. Its final year combines 30 EC genuine choice with the 30 EC general track, including a 10 EC thesis. First-year GROW is 1 EC; later GROW is 0. No route mixing or invented elective content.

sources.sections: Possible occupations; teacher qualification; reported graduates; subsequent masters
sources.finding: Ethical, policy and research examples are outcomes. Teaching requires later master and teacher training. Freelance training/advice is reported; journalism is not substantiated here.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Filosofie bachelor. Filosofie Algemeen continues the common programme’s four broad Philosophy pillars and scientific-research identity, whereas Ondernemen narrows toward an internship and applied organisational research. The route was selected before and independently of UCR course selection; the separate 30-ECTS free-choice semester remains uninstantiated.

progression: Year-two thesis preparation precedes year-three thesis. No additional formal entry threshold claimed. Current official curriculum sufficiently resolves EC, statuses and tracks; no conflicting requirement or redundant OER gate.
componentStatus: All listed taught components and thesis/preparation are compulsory within chosen General route. The sole open component is 30 EC choice space. Entrepreneurship route remains separate.
